sections.description: Overview of Jeanne Bliss's early leadership role at Land's End and her subsequent cross-industry application of customer-centric strategy to unify leadership around delivering experiences centered on the customer.
sections.title: Career path and customer-centric leadership

summary: In this concise talk, Jeanne Bliss describes how she helped pioneer the Chief Customer Officer (CCO) role by placing the customer at the center of business strategy and experience across multiple industries. Beginning at Land's End, she collaborated with the executive committee to design how products and services would be delivered. Over roughly two decades, she moved across industries—Mazda, Coldwell Banker, Allstate, and Microsoft—taking on roles that did not previously exist, all with the aim of uniting leadership around a single customer-centric approach and growing the business by focusing on the customer's life.
title: Pioneering the Chief Customer Officer: Jeanne Bliss's cross-industry customer-centric leadership
topics: Deliberate career path applying CX lessons
